name: junzle-core-surfaces
description: Junzle Core Phase 1 Surfaces: Mobile App, Super Admin Panel, and Member Portal

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "ADMIN,PORTAL,MOBILE" -c "blue,yellow,magenta" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:portal" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:admin && npm run build:portal
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix super-admin install && npm --prefix member-portal install && npm --prefix mobile-app install
